ns2:section.sectionText: Musical Theatre Repertoire is an asynchronous course, conducted by means of the interactive, video feedback platform GoReact. Fall semester is dedicated to the context, selection, and performance of Contemporary Musical Theatre Repertoire covering genres such as comedic/character selections, Sondheim, Disney, pop/rock, punk, country, disco, and motown. Spring semester is dedicated to pre-1970 musical theatre repertoire ranging from operetta through post-golden age repertoire. Feedback concerning vocal technique, musical and stylistic choices, and communication is given each week.
